from pathlib import Path
programs = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program = '''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half = [row[:] for row in grid] + clockwise
    lower = counterclockwise + [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [half[r] + (clockwise[r] if False else []) for r in range(n)] + []
'''
# Use explicit quadrant assembly: top row block concatenates original + clockwise; bottom block ccw + 180-degree rotation.
program = '''def transform(grid):
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(len(grid))] + [counterclockwise[r] + half_turn[r] for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
